sentences.en: That country intervened in the internal affairs of our nation.

sentences.en: That politician is well versed in internal and external conditions.
sentences.zh: 那位政治家对内外情况都很熟悉。

sentences.en: I haven't yet read the new memorandum on internal security.
sentences.zh: 我还没有看过关于内部安全的新备忘录。
